issues.problem: no-possessive mistake 3: 本の友達 is grammatical ('a book friend'); the note did not say why it is wrong for the intended meaning.
issues.action: Rewrote the note to state what 本の友達 means and that the owner comes first.

issues.problem: no-nominalizer tip sent 'ability' to こと, which would produce the less natural 料理を作ることが上手 when 上手 takes のが.
issues.action: Rewrote the tip: の for perception/help/wait verbs, こと for definitions before です and できる/ある/にする.

issues.problem: no-pronoun tip ('English says one') would also fire for the numeral 'one' (一つ).
issues.action: Narrowed it to 'one' standing in for a noun, plus mine/yours.

issues.problem: no-explanatory mistake 2: 電車が止まっていました as an excuse is a natural sentence, so the 'bad' sentence was not actually wrong.
issues.action: Replaced it with a real error, 痛いなんです vs 痛いんです (い-adjectives take no な).
